real_data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), subject S001, run R02 (eyes closed), channel O1
authors: Schalk G, McFarland DJ, Hinterberger T, Birbaumer N, Wolpaw JR
record_used: S001R02 O1 @ 160 Hz, 9760 samples; real alpha peak 10.0 Hz (rel-alpha 0.67). Jansen-Rit membrane time constants scaled x0.960 to match the real alpha frequency, plus a fitted 1/f background of amplitude 1.80 (jansenRit aperiodic=) to match the real relative alpha; model rel-alpha 0.65 (was 0.99 without the 1/f background).
